text:
```yaml
name: Check Milestone

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  check-milestone:
    name: Check Milestone
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.pull_request.milestone == null
    steps:
      - name: Fail if no milestone is set
        run: |
          echo "::error::A milestone is required for this pull request."
          exit 1
```
